scope: complete F1+F2 passes without intermediate annealing

engineering.status: configurable trial settings, not manufacturer-certified quality or safety limits
engineering.reference_ceiling_basis: retained 1060 O F1 geometric search ceiling; other stages are reduced using material and hardening priors and must pass equipment screening
engineering.alloy_capacity_mapping: sqrt(reference strength / alloy strength), engineering sensitivity only; 1100 constrained by the manufacturer relative range

sources.title: ASM Handbook Volume 2 Aluminum Mill and Engineered Wrought Products
sources.locator: Table 8 printed page 49; strain hardening discussion and Figure 8
sources.use: typical yield-strength knots for 1060, 1100 and 3003; supports material differences, not a universal allowable rolling reduction
